name: Aldabra Atoll
description: Aldabra is a remote ring of four large coral islands in the Indian Ocean, about 1,120 km southwest of Victoria, the capital of the Seychelles. Together they enclose a shallow lagoon and are fringed by a coral reef. The atoll is among the world's largest, and its isolation has kept people away. That is why it still shelters roughly 152,000 giant tortoises, the biggest population on Earth.
